_note: 自测用例。全部为合成文本，用于验证脚本能否抓出已知的改动错误，不是赛事正式案例。

cases.description: 可能性被改成断言 + 精度被抬高
cases.original: The treatment may reduce the incidence by about 12% in coastal areas [3].
cases.bad: The treatment reduces the incidence by 12% in coastal areas [3].
cases.good: The treatment may reduce the incidence by approximately 12% in coastal areas [3].

cases.description: 阴性结果被改写成等价性判断
cases.original: Sea fog frequency was not significant at inland stations.
cases.bad: Sea fog frequency was similar at inland stations.
cases.good: Sea fog frequency was not statistically significant at inland stations.

cases.description: 样本量与引用编号在改写中丢失
cases.original: A total of 14 stations recorded 2779 fog samples (1.33%) from 2015 to 2020 [12].
cases.bad: A total of 14 stations recorded fog samples (1.33%) from 2015 to 2020.
cases.good: In total, 14 stations recorded 2779 fog samples (1.33%) between 2015 and 2020 [12].

cases.description: 阴性表述词种类未变但出现次数从 3 降到 1，旧版按 len 判定会漏报
cases.original: At station A it was not significant. At station B it was not significant. At station C it was not significant.
cases.bad: At station A it was not significant. At station B it was not significant. At station C the effect was observed.
cases.good: At station A it was not significant. At station B it was not significant. At station C it was not statistically significant.

cases.description: 中文阴性/收窄表述被换成正向断言，negation 次数下降且 scope 增强
cases.original: 该路线在国内公开文献中尚不多见，结论站不住；仍有部分站点未见差异。
cases.bad: 该路线在国内公开文献中十分常见，结论完全成立；所有站点均如此。
cases.good: 该路线在国内公开文献中尚不多见，结论站不住；仍有部分站点未见差异。

cases.description: 缩写首次定义被删，只剩裸缩写；词表里没有任何相关词，靠①有限集合守恒抓出
cases.original: We improved the probability of detection (POD) and the false alarm ratio (FAR) in sea fog prediction.
cases.bad: We improved POD and FAR in sea fog prediction.
cases.good: We improved the probability of detection (POD) and the false alarm ratio (FAR) in sea fog forecasting.

cases.description: 边界表达 at least 被删，命题从'至少'变成确数；靠①有限集合守恒抓出
cases.original: Visibility was below 1 km for at least 60 hours at the coastal station.
cases.bad: Visibility was below 1 km for 60 hours at the coastal station.
cases.good: Visibility stayed below 1 km for at least 60 hours at the coastal site.

cases.description: aims to develop 改成 develops，意图变既成事实；即使留痕齐全也必须报③红线
cases.original: This study aims to develop a sea fog prediction model using satellite data.
cases.bad: This study develops a sea fog prediction model using satellite data.
cases.good: This study aims to develop a satellite-based sea fog prediction model.

cases.description: 同一术语三种写法；bad 未统一，good 统一到术语表首选写法
cases.original: Sea-Fog events were frequent in spring. Sea Fog intensity varied by station.
cases.bad: sea fog events were frequent in spring. sea fog intensity varied by station.
cases.good: Sea Fog events were frequent in spring. Sea Fog intensity varied by station.

cases.description: 中式英语硬错误 + 直译腔开场；bad 应报，good 干净
cases.original: With the rapid development of deep learning, image classification has attracted more and more attention. There has a lot of methods that make an analysis of images. The reason is because models play an important role in it.
cases.bad: With the rapid development of deep learning, image classification has attracted more and more attention. There has a lot of methods that make an analysis of images. The reason is because models play an important role in it.
cases.good: Deep learning has advanced rapidly, and image classification has drawn increasing attention. Many methods analyze images; models are central to this task because they capture hierarchical features.

cases.description: 冗余名词化应报 error，动词直用作谓语的干净版本不报
cases.original: We carried out an investigation of the fog events and made a comparison with the baseline.
cases.bad: We carried out an investigation of the fog events and made a comparison with the baseline.
cases.good: We investigated the fog events and compared them with the baseline.

cases.description: 中文空话套话应报；改为具体贡献的干净版本不报
cases.original: 众所周知，在当今社会，该方法具有重要的理论意义和现实意义。
cases.bad: 众所周知，在当今社会，该方法具有重要的理论意义和现实意义。
cases.good: 该方法把预报误差从 12% 降到 7%，并在 14 个沿海站得到验证。

cases.description: 负样本：with respect to 是数学/统计固定搭配，不得报 filler
cases.original: The partial derivative with respect to each parameter was computed.
cases.bad: The partial derivative with respect to each parameter was computed.
cases.good: The partial derivative with respect to each parameter was computed.

cases.description: 负样本：在…方面 是正常中文学术表达，不得报 translationese
cases.original: 在误差控制方面，本文采用三折交叉验证。
cases.bad: 在误差控制方面，本文采用三折交叉验证。
cases.good: 在误差控制方面，本文采用三折交叉验证。
